goal: GR's doctor replay and its tests follow K13's rule D, so ga can move its rlo pin (CMD-GA25) without red tests.
why: CMD-GA25 (#12 5975403405) bumped ga's rlo pin and 6 GR tests fail on one replay case, 'remote.replay.Bash after 2h idle', which still expects a rule-D deny. K13 (rlo 0.8.0, BD-246/257, option B) changed D on purpose: stale-only health no longer cuts a session off; D denies only when health is unknown (health_ttl=True restores the old D). Following K13 is the point of POL-1 T1 (the W1 lockout fix). GA holds its pin commit until this lands (BD-228: no red push).

scope.text: Update the doctor replay so 'Bash after 2h idle' expects K13's D on rlo >= 0.8 (stale-only: not denied by D), and add a replay case where health is unknown that D still denies. If the expectation must depend on the installed rlo, gate it on the rlo version the doctor reports, not on a sha.
Do not ask for the old D in the guard preset (no health_ttl=True); K13's D is the intended behaviour.

Run GR's tests against rlo c491e96 (0.8.2), the new rlo integration head, and against the current pin 3d2e7d0; both green. Touch only GR's files (ga/rlo/*, tests/test_rlo*, tests/test_gr*, tests/test_remote*).

done_when.text: The 6 tests GA listed pass with rlo c491e96 and with 3d2e7d0; the new unknown-health case is denied by D; a mutation that makes D deny stale-only health again is killed on 0.8.2.
Report as report/2 in English on #15 with the commit sha; then notify AO.
